_comment: The index lists every page in tools/, newest first, by each file's last commit date (or its modification time while uncommitted). This file only overrides what a page says about itself; listing order here means nothing. Fields: title, description, hidden.

nmr-1d-explorer.html.title: Lipoate NMR Explorer
nmr-1d-explorer.html.description: Five ¹H and ¹³C spectra – ethyl lipoate, ethanol, lipoic acid, and two mixtures. Peaks assigned by Claude with overview.

ternary_mixture_explorer.html.title: Ternary Mixture Explorer
ternary_mixture_explorer.html.description: Data from a ternary mixture screening run. 16 LpOH/TFEA/acrylamide compositions in THF, plus blanks and repeats, each with UV, IR, and ¹H/¹⁹F NMR spectra.

tube-color-explorer.html.title: Color Mixing Explorer
tube-color-explorer.html.description: Data from prototype color mixing demo. 63 different mixtures of red, blue, and yellow dyes with UV-vis spectra and images.

color_mixer_demo.html.title: Color mixer demo
color_mixer_demo.html.description: Interactive COAST PCL color mixer. Dial a dye recipe or pick a colour off the wheel, and watch it mix, flow down the tube, and be measured.

color_target_demo.html.title: Color target demo
color_target_demo.html.description: Interactive closed-loop colour targeting. Pick a colour on the wheel and watch the rig sample, measure and correct its way to a match.
